dict.string: Mac Cleaner scans new downloads for malware and finds old installers and large files you may want to remove.
Mac Cleaner scans files on your Desktop for malware and includes it in storage and duplicate scans.
Mac Cleaner scans your documents for malware and includes them in storage and duplicate scans. Nothing is removed without your review.
Mac Cleaner scans external drives for malware and shows what takes up space on them when you ask.
Mac Cleaner asks System Events for your login items so you can review and remove them. It never controls other apps without your action.
